_doc: Curation for tools/build-gallery.mjs (npm run gallery). Keys are atomic numbers as strings. exclude: Commons file titles (File:...) to drop even though an article uses them. include: extra Commons files to add; their license is still checked and they are dropped if not free; captions stay null unless an article supplies one. first: the file that should lead the gallery. Everything else comes from the Spanish and English Wikipedia articles, Spanish article order first, then English additions. Re-run npm run gallery after editing.
